decisions: Resolved fix-request-review-1.md item 9 (missing deterministic validation) by running lint, typecheck, unit test, build, test:architecture, migration:run+revert on a disposable empty database, and test:e2e against the real docker-compose test stack (postgres/redis/minio); all passed in this cycle.

Items 1-8 of fix-request-review-1.md were already implemented in the worktree carried over from implementation cycle 1 (JwtAuthGuard live Account status/tokenVersion check, PortalGuard on UserProfileController, atomic compare-and-swap refresh rotation, userProfileId retained on refresh, OriginGuard on /auth/refresh, RequestContext.currentActorId() used for audit actor, dateOnlyTransformer fixing UserProfile.dateOfBirth, and removal of the fake generic PATCH /accounts/:accountId endpoint). This cycle verified each by code inspection and passing tests rather than re-implementing.

Fixed a genuine regression found while running test:e2e: auth-flow.e2e-spec.ts's refresh/logout tests predated the OriginGuard fix and never set an Origin header, so they failed with 403 once CORS_ORIGIN was configured. Added a `refresh()` helper that sets Origin to the first configured CORS origin, updated all refresh call sites, and added a new explicit test asserting refresh is rejected (403) with a missing or disallowed Origin and still succeeds afterwards with the allowed one.

Killed a stray leftover `dist/apps/worker/main` process (PID 68449, from a prior interrupted implementation attempt) that was holding port 9464 and causing media-upload-flow.e2e-spec.ts to fail with EADDRINUSE; unrelated to this cycle's code changes.

Interpreted AC30 ("Account CRUD API hoạt động") as satisfied without a generic `PATCH /accounts/:accountId` route: Account's domain model has no updatable fields beyond status/phone/password (task.md §2 explicitly excludes profile data), each of which already has its own dedicated, permission-scoped endpoint. The route list in task.md §16 is presented as a proposal ("Route đề xuất"), and task.md explicitly forbids updating password/phone through a generic update DTO, leaving nothing for a generic PATCH to legitimately do.

Per requirement-addendum.md cycle 1 (backend-only), treated AC10/AC11 (portal-specific login) as fully satisfied by backend E2E coverage of POST /auth/login with portal=PUBLIC/ADMIN, since no frontend exists in scope to originate the request. AC19 (access token kept in memory) is a frontend storage concern with no frontend in scope; the backend does not persist or dictate client-side storage, so it is treated as not applicable to this cycle rather than failed.

Verified (not re-implemented) that Account creation's transaction genuinely spans the identity-access/user-profiles module boundary: both modules' TypeORM repositories resolve their active connection through the same AsyncLocalStorage-backed TypeOrmQueryRunnerContext, so UserProfileProvisioner.provision() participates in CreateAccountUseCase's single UnitOfWork.withTransaction (AC29).
